text:
Amelia: Quick heads-up — we have an SI "shadow day" with IntegratorX next Thursday 9:30–13:00 PT. Need enablement + ops to run labs and do a live checklist run.

Raj: I can take the marketplace/hw partner segment. What hardware are they bringing?

Luis: They're bringing a 4-node A100 rack and want to validate Dedicated capacity + private VPC networking.

Marta: I'll own the certification pre-checklist and the training exam flow. Can we carve 40 mins for an exam walk-through?

Amelia: Yes — proposed agenda:
```
09:30 intro + scope (10m)
09:40 infra walkthrough (20m)
10:00 live deploy + routing test (40m)
10:45 batching & perf demo (20m)
11:10 breakout: SI labs (40m)
11:50 certification Q&A (20m)
12:10 next steps & handoff (20m)
```

OnboardBot: Reminder: IntegratorX signed NDA, share-only demo data (no customer PII). See https://internal.redwood/signing/integX

Raj: For the hw segment I'll need a short checklist. Proposed checklist:
- S1: confirm VPC peering
- S2: firewall rules for gRPC/443
- S3: GPU driver & kernel versions (match runtime)
- S4: test load generator + KV cache warmup

Marta: I'll attach the exam rubric in a follow-up; also want to run a mock cert with one of their engineers during the breakout.

Amelia: Volunteers to run the live deploy? Need someone familiar with Dedicated autoscale config and Canary rollouts.

Luis: I can run deploys. Also want to validate quantization profile — IntegratorX asked about INT8 tradeoffs.

Raj: I'll coordinate with marketplace team to check listing permissions post-demo — we might do a joint announcement if everything is green. Can someone confirm comms readiness?

Marta: Marketing pinged me earlier; they want to wait until SI has passing certs + Marketplace listing. I'll sync with them after the mock cert.

Amelia: OK — action items:
- Luis: run deploy + perf demo (owner)
- Raj: hw + marketplace liaison (owner)
- Marta: cert rubric + mock exam (owner)
- Amelia: compile post-shadow notes + joint announcement checklist

Amelia: @here if anyone can't make Thurs please shout now, otherwise I'll lock the calendar and send invites.

Raj: I'm in. :thumbsup:

Luis: in as well.

Marta: I might be 10 mins late but confirmed.

OnboardBot: Event created: shadow-day-integX-2024-11-07 (calendar invite sent)
